_comment: All scoring behavior is configured here. Nothing in scoring.service.ts is hardcoded — change these values (or point SCORING_CONFIG_PATH at a different file) to change how products are ranked, without touching code.
_finalScoreWeightsComment: Must sum to 1.0, and all seven keys are required. Weights apply only to sub-scores that are NOT null for a given product; the remaining weights are renormalized proportionally so a product missing one optional signal isn't unfairly punished — see computeFinalScore() in scoring-functions.ts.

demandScore._comment: demand_score = 0.7 * normalized(ln(review_count+1) within category cohort) + 0.3 * (avg_rating/5*100). Requires review_count AND avg_rating; otherwise null.

competitionOpportunityScore._comment: competitionOpportunityScore = 100 - normalized(competitor_count within category cohort) - establishedBrandDominancePenalty (if flagged). 100 = attractive/low-competition environment, 0 = brutal/high-competition. Requires competitor_count; otherwise null.

differentiationScore._comment: differentiationScore = min(distinct_opportunity_count * pointsPerOpportunity, 100). Requires at least one product_pain_points row (of any type) to exist for the product to distinguish 'not researched' (null) from 'researched, zero opportunities found' (0).

customerPainOpportunityScore._comment: customerPainOpportunityScore = min(complaint_count * pointsPerComplaint, 100). More documented complaints on competing listings = more room to win by fixing them. Requires at least one pain_points row to exist; otherwise null.

shippingSimplicityScore._comment: 100 minus penalties. Requires weight_kg; otherwise null.

bundleExpansionScore._comment: Manual override (products.bundle_potential_score, entered by the researcher) always wins. Otherwise, fall back to a documented per-category baseline heuristic below. If the category isn't listed and there's no manual value, the score is null (never fabricated).

profitabilityScore._comment: profitabilityScore = clamp(0-100) of profit_margin_percentage scaled linearly between marginFloorPct (->0) and marginCeilingPct (->100). Requires a computed profitability result; otherwise null.

riskScore._comment: risk_score is 0-100 (higher = riskier) and is NOT part of final_score. It drives classification alongside final_score. Each triggered penalty is recorded in risk_reasons so the score is always traceable.
